task_ids.description: IDs of the tasks to update, 1 to 100, each positive. A repeated id is updated once.

status.description: The status to set on every listed ticket. A closed ticket cannot be moved to another status.

ticket_ids.description: IDs of the tickets to update, 1 to 100, each positive. A repeated id is updated once.

current_password.description: The account's current password; a wrong value is a 400.

new_password.description:
New password: at least 10 characters with an uppercase letter, a
lowercase letter, a digit and a special character. More than 72 bytes
fails with 500 (bcrypt limit).

refresh_token.description:
Optional: the caller's current refresh token. With bearer
authentication it renews that session (the response then carries new
credentials); it must be a live refresh token of the caller or the
request fails with 409 SESSION_STALE. Ignored for API-key requests.

internal_handler.ChangePasswordResponse.description: Result of POST /auth/change-password. token, refresh_token and user are present only when the current session was renewed.

refresh_token.description: Replacement refresh token; present only when the session was renewed.

token.description: Replacement access token (JWT); present only when the session was renewed.

user.description: The account; present only when the session was renewed.

internal_handler.ChartData.description: Chart payload of the distribution and time-series widgets: category labels and a single dataset of counts.

datasets.description: Exactly one dataset whose data is index-aligned with labels; never null.

labels.description: Category labels (statuses, priorities or time buckets) in display order; never null.

internal_handler.ChartDataset.description: One series of a chart: a label and one count per chart label.

data.description: Counts, index-aligned with the chart's labels; never null.

label.description: Series name, fixed per endpoint: Leads, Tickets, Tasks or Conversions.

domain.description:
Domain or URL; stored normalised (lower case, scheme, path, query,
fragment, a leading "www." and a trailing dot removed). What remains
may hold only letters, digits, dots and hyphens (400 otherwise) and
must not be used by another live company (409). At most 255
characters as sent. Absent or empty clears it on update.

employee_range.description: Head-count band; absent or empty stores no band.

name.description:
Company name, required; trimmed, it must not be empty. At most 200
characters.

notes.description: Free-text notes, at most 65535 bytes (UTF-8 bytes, not characters).

owner_id.description:
Account manager. Create: a sales user may send only its own id and
gets itself when it is absent or 0; an admin may name any user, or
leave the company unowned. Update: absent keeps the owner, 0 clears it
(admin only), another id sets it (sales: its own id only). An id that
names no live user is 400 INVALID_REFERENCE.

state.description: State or region, at most 100 characters.

website.description:
Website: an http or https URL with a host, trimmed (400 otherwise). At
most 255 characters. Absent or empty clears it on update.

configurations.description: The entries, never null (an empty list is []).

internal_handler.ConfigurationResponse.description: A configuration entry as the API returns it. A sensitive entry (is_sensitive) always carries an empty value; is_set tells whether one is stored.

category.description: Category the entry is listed under. Seeded, read-only.

created_at.description: When the record was created (RFC 3339 date-time), set by the server. Read-only.

default_value.description:
Value that POST /configurations/{key}/reset restores, in the same text
form as value. Empty for sensitive entries. Seeded, read-only.

deleted_at.description: Soft-deletion time (RFC 3339 date-time) or null. Always present in the JSON. Reads exclude soft-deleted rows, so records returned by the API carry null here. Read-only.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the setting. Seeded, read-only.
description.example: Whether the public /auth/register endpoint accepts new sign-ups

id.description: Unique identifier, assigned by the server on creation. Read-only.

is_read_only.description:
True when the entry cannot be changed through the API: PUT and reset
answer 400. The synthetic entries of GET /configurations/ui carry true.
Seeded, read-only.

is_sensitive.description:
True for a secret (the AEO provider API keys). The value is encrypted at
rest, read back only through the service's GetSecret and never included
in an API response: reads report whether it is set (is_set), not what it
is. Seeded, read-only.

is_set.description:
Whether the entry currently holds a non-empty value, computed before
masking. For a sensitive entry it is the only evidence of its content.
Read-only.

is_system.description:
Marks an entry the application itself seeds and relies on.
Informational: the API has no delete operation. Seeded, read-only.

key.description:
Unique dotted key, "<category>.<name>". Seeded by the server; the API
cannot create, rename or delete entries. Read-only.

type.description: Declared type of the value. Seeded, read-only.

updated_at.description: When the record was last written (RFC 3339 date-time), set by the server on every update. Read-only.

valid_values.description:
JSON array text listing the allowed values, or "" for no constraint. For
an array entry every element must be listed. A list that does not parse
as JSON imposes no constraint. Seeded, read-only.

value.description:
Current value in its stored text form: "true"/"false" for boolean, a
decimal for integer, JSON text for float, json and array, the raw text for
string. Always "" for a sensitive entry in API responses (see is_set).

address.description: Postal address stored on the new customer.

company_name.description:
Company name for the new customer; empty or absent takes the lead's
free-text company.

notes.description:
Notes stored on the new customer. Required (not blank) when the
leads.conversion.require_notes setting is on: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
with details.field "notes".

website.description:
Website stored on the new customer: trimmed, at most 255 characters,
an http or https URL with a host (400 BAD_REQUEST otherwise). May be
empty.

prompts.description:
Prompt texts to track: 1 to 25 entries, each non-empty and at most 500
characters. Entries are trimmed; a whitespace-only entry, a repeat within
the request (case-insensitive) or a text matching a live prompt rejects
the whole batch.
example: What is the best self-hosted CRM for a small sales team?
Which CRM tools support embeddable lead-capture forms?

expires_at.description:
Optional expiry as an RFC 3339 timestamp, which must lie in the future.
Omitted or empty: the key never expires.

name.description: Label for the key, 3 to 100 characters. Names need not be unique.

internal_handler.CreateAPIKeyResponse.description: Result of POST /api-keys: the plaintext key, shown only this once, and the stored record.

api_key.description: The stored key record (prefix, expiry, active flag).

key.description:
The plaintext key: gcrm_ followed by 64 hexadecimal characters. Returned
only here; store it now, it cannot be retrieved later.

internal_handler.CreateCustomerRequest.description: Body of POST /customers. Text fields other than the names and email are optional free text.

company.description: Free-text company name; independent of company_id.

company_id.description:
Optional link to a live company record; 0 or absent means no link. An id
matching no live company is 400 INVALID_REFERENCE.

email.description:
Email address; required, valid, and not used by any customer, erased
ones included (409).

website.description:
Optional web site: an absolute http or https URL with a host, at most 255
characters after trimming.

allowed_domains.description:
Origin allowlist of bare host names with optional port (no scheme, no
path), lower-cased on save; empty allows every origin. At most 20, each
at most 255 characters.

captcha_enabled.description:
Require a reCAPTCHA v3 token; ignored unless the server has both
reCAPTCHA keys.

confirmation_body.description:
Confirmation mail body (plain text) with an optional {confirmation_link}
placeholder; the link is appended when the placeholder is missing.

confirmation_subject.description:
Confirmation mail subject, at most 255 characters; empty means a
built-in subject.

consent_text.description:
Consent statement; when non-empty every submission must carry
consent=true.
consent_text.example: I agree to be contacted about my enquiry.

content_url.description: Link substituted for {content_link}, at most 512 characters.

create_lead.description:
Feed accepted submissions into leads. Absent means true; send false
explicitly to turn it off.

default_owner_id.description:
Owner of created leads; 0 means none. Must be non-zero when create_lead
is true or absent, and any non-zero value must name an existing, active
admin or sales user.

description.description: Internal description for staff; never shown publicly.
description.example: Contact form on the pricing page.

double_opt_in.description:
Enable double opt-in (confirmation mail with a 48-hour single-use link
before the submission counts).

fields.description:
Ordered field definitions, 1 to 50. Exactly one field of type email,
named "email"; names unique and matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,49}$; select
fields need 1 to 50 non-blank options and only select fields may have
options; hidden fields cannot be required.

follow_up_body.description:
Follow-up mail body (plain text); {content_link} is replaced by
content_url. Empty means a built-in text.

follow_up_subject.description:
Follow-up mail subject, at most 255 characters; empty disables the
follow-up mail.

name.description: Form name; required, at most 255 characters, not blank once trimmed.

notify_emails.description:
Staff addresses notified of each accepted submission: at most 20, each
at most 255 characters and shaped like an email address (trimmed).

redirect_url.description:
Target page when submit_action is redirect: required then and must
start with http:// or https:// (trimmed). At most 512 characters.

status.description:
Publication state; absent or empty means draft. Only published forms are
served publicly.

submit_action.description: message (default when absent or empty) or redirect.

thank_you_message.description:
Message shown after submitting when submit_action is message; empty
means a built-in text.
thank_you_message.example: Thanks, we will be in touch within one business day.

color.description: Colour as #RRGGBB: a hash and exactly six hex digits (the three-digit shorthand is refused).

name.description: Display name, 1 to 50 characters. Trimmed before it is stored; blank after trimming is 400. Must be unique case-insensitively (409).

company.description: Free-text employer name, independent of company_id.

company_id.description:
Company record to link; 0 or absent means no link. An id that names
no live company is 400 INVALID_REFERENCE.

created_at.description:
Original creation time for imports. Accepted layouts: RFC 3339,
2006-01-02T15:04:05Z, "2006-01-02 15:04:05" (UTC) and 2006-01-02. A
value in no accepted layout is ignored silently and the current time
is used.

email.description:
Email address, validated when present. Either email or a non-blank
phone is required.

external_id.description: Identifier in an external system, for imports.

first_name.description:
Given name. Required, any non-empty string (100-character column, not
checked by the API).

last_name.description:
Family name. Required, any non-empty string (100-character column, not
checked by the API).

notes.description:
Free-text notes, at most 65535 bytes (UTF-8 bytes; a longer value is
400 BAD_REQUEST).

owner_id.description:
Owner of the lead. Required for admins (400 without it); a sales user
may omit it (the lead is then its own) or send its own id, any other id
is 403. Not checked against the users table by the handler.

phone.description: Phone number, free text. Either a non-blank phone or email is required.

status.description:
Initial status; new when omitted. converted passes the binding but is
refused with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (details.field "status"), so it is
not listed among the accepted values: only POST /leads/{id}/convert
converts a lead.

assigned_to_id.description: ID of the user to assign the task to. Required (non-zero). Non-admin callers must send their own user id; admins may name any active user.

customer_id.description: ID of a customer to link. The customer must exist, otherwise 404. Cannot be combined with lead_id.

description.description: Free-text details.
description.example: Customer asked for a quote on the 50-seat plan.

label_ids.description:
IDs of existing labels to attach, at most 100, each positive (the cap
bounds the IN clause a single request can produce). Absent or empty means
no labels; a repeated id is attached once; an id that matches no label
rejects the whole request with 400 INVALID_REFERENCE.

lead_id.description: ID of a lead to link. The lead must exist and be visible to the caller (admins any lead, sales users only the leads they own, every other role none), otherwise 404. Cannot be combined with customer_id.

priority.description: Priority; medium when omitted or empty.

title.description: Short summary of the task. Required (non-empty). Not length-checked by the API; the column is 255 characters wide.

internal_handler.CreateTicketCommentRequ.description: Body of POST /tickets/{id}/comments. The text may come in body, comment or content.

body.description: The comment text. The first of body, comment and content that is not blank after trimming is stored (trimmed); all three blank is 400.
body.example: Rolled back the firmware; waiting for the customer to confirm.

comment.description: Alias of body, used only when body is blank.

content.description: Alias of body, used only when body and comment are blank.

is_internal.description: True for an internal note, visible to staff only and never returned to customer callers. Defaults to false.

assigned_to_id.description: ID of the support or admin user to assign. Omitted or null assigns the caller. An unknown user or a user of another role is 400.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer the ticket is for. Required (non-zero); an unknown customer is 404.

description.description: Full description of the problem. Required (non-empty).
description.example: Since this morning the office printer no longer appears on the network.

priority.description: Priority; medium when omitted or empty.

title.description: Short summary. Required (non-empty). Not length-checked by the API; the column is 255 characters wide.

internal_handler.CreateUserRequest.description: Body of POST /users (admin). Unlike public registration, the requested role is honoured.

email.description: Login email address; must be valid and not used by any account (409).

password.description:
Initial password: at least 10 characters with an uppercase letter, a
lowercase letter, a digit and a special character. More than 72 bytes is
answered with 400 (bcrypt limit).

role.description: Role of the new account; required, one of admin, sales, support, customer.

customers.description: The customers of this page, never null.

total.description:
Total number of customers matching the query, across all pages (also
in meta.total, where it is omitted when 0).

internal_handler.DashboardStats.description: System-wide counters of the dashboard; never narrowed to the caller.

conversion_rate.description:
total_customers / total_leads * 100 as an unrounded percentage, 0 when
there are no leads. Customers created directly count too, so it can
exceed 100.

open_tickets.description: Number of tickets whose status is open or in_progress.

pending_tasks.description: Number of tasks whose status is pending or in_progress.

total_leads.description: Number of live leads, every status included.

amount_cents.description:
Value in minor units (cents for EUR), 0 to 1000000000000. Absent means
0, on update as well.

company_id.description:
Company link: absent keeps it (none on create), 0 clears it, another
id must name a live company (400 INVALID_REFERENCE).

currency.description:
ISO 4217 code, exactly three upper-case ASCII letters. Create: the
deals.default_currency setting (EUR as shipped) when absent. Update:
absent keeps the stored code.

customer_id.description:
Customer link: absent keeps it (none on create), 0 clears it, another
id must name a live customer (400 INVALID_REFERENCE).

expected_close_date.description:
Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (400 BAD_REQUEST for any other form). Absent
or empty clears it, on update as well.

lead_id.description:
Lead link: absent keeps it (none on create), 0 clears it, another id
must name a live lead the caller may see (admins any lead, sales users
the leads they own); a hidden lead is the same 400 INVALID_REFERENCE as
a missing one. A sent id is always checked, even when it equals the
stored link.

lost_reason.description:
Reason for losing, at most 255 characters (trimmed when the stage
changes); stored only when the resulting stage is lost and cleared
otherwise. Absent on update clears it.

notes.description:
Free-text notes, at most 65535 bytes (UTF-8 bytes, not characters).
Absent on update clears them.
notes.example: Decision expected after the board meeting.

owner_id.description:
Owner, at least 1. Create: the caller when absent. Update: absent keeps
the owner. A sales user may only send its own id (403 otherwise); an
admin may name any live user (400 INVALID_REFERENCE otherwise).

probability.description:
Win probability in percent, 0 to 100. When the deal enters a stage and
this is absent, the stage's default applies (10, 40, 70); won is
always 100 and lost always 0 whatever is sent. On an update that keeps
the stage, absent keeps the stored probability.

source.description:
Where the deal came from, at most 100 characters. Absent on update
clears it.

stage.description:
Stage. Create: qualification when absent. Update: absent keeps the
stored stage; a different stage is a stage change with the rules of
POST /deals/{id}/stage.

title.description:
Deal title, required; trimmed, it must not be empty. At most 200
characters.

lost_reason.description:
Reason for losing, at most 255 characters, trimmed. Used only when the
target stage is lost; absent keeps the reason already stored. Any other
target stage clears the reason.

probability.description:
Win probability in percent, 0 to 100; absent takes the new stage's
default (10, 40, 70). Ignored for won (always 100) and lost (always 0).

allowed_domains.description:
Origin allowlist: bare host names with an optional port, lower-cased,
matched exactly (subdomains must be listed one by one). Empty allows
every origin. A definition requested from another origin is a 404; a
submission from another origin is stored as spam (reason domain). At
most 20, each at most 255 characters. Reads return [] when there are
none; the POST /forms and PUT /forms/{id} responses echo the request and
carry null when the list was omitted or sent as null.

captcha_enabled.description:
Require a reCAPTCHA v3 token with each submission. Takes effect only
when the server has both reCAPTCHA keys; otherwise it is ignored.

confirmation_subject.description:
Subject of the confirmation mail, at most 255 characters; empty means
"Confirm your email address".

consent_text.description:
Consent statement shown with the form. When non-empty, a submission must
carry consent=true or it is rejected with a field error on "consent".
consent_text.example: I agree to be contacted about my enquiry.

content_url.description:
Link inserted for {content_link} in the follow-up mail (for gated
content). At most 512 characters; not checked for a scheme.

create_lead.description:
Whether an accepted submission feeds a lead: the newest live lead with
the same address gains a note, otherwise a new lead (status new, owner
default_owner_id, source the form name) is created.

created_at.description: When the record was created (RFC 3339 date-time), set by the server. Read-only.

created_by_id.description: ID of the user who created the form; server-assigned and immutable.

default_owner_id.description:
Owner of the leads the form creates; 0 means none. Required when
create_lead is true; any non-zero value names an active admin or sales
user (checked on save only).

deleted_at.description: Soft-deletion time (RFC 3339 date-time) or null. Always present in the JSON. Reads exclude soft-deleted rows, so records returned by the API carry null here. Read-only.

description.description: Internal description for staff; never exposed by the public endpoints.
description.example: Contact form on the pricing page.

double_opt_in.description:
Double opt-in: a submission is stored as pending and a confirmation
mail with a single-use link valid for 48 hours goes to the submitted
address; the lead, the notification and the follow-up mail wait until
the link is confirmed.

fields.description:
Ordered field definitions (1 to 50), normalised on save (names trimmed,
max_length defaulted and clamped).

follow_up_body.description:
Plain-text body of the follow-up mail; {content_link} is replaced by
content_url. Empty means a built-in text containing the link.
follow_up_body.example: Thanks for your interest. Download the guide here: {content_link}

follow_up_subject.description:
Subject of the follow-up mail sent to the submitter once the submission
is accepted; empty means no follow-up mail is sent. At most 255
characters.

id.description: Unique identifier, assigned by the server on creation. Read-only.

name.description:
Form name, trimmed; at most 255 characters. Shown to visitors, used as
the source of the leads the form creates (cut to 100 characters) and in
notification subjects.

notify_emails.description:
Staff addresses that receive one notification mail per accepted
submission (on arrival, or on confirmation for double opt-in forms). At
most 20, each at most 255 characters and shaped like an address; trimmed.
Reads return [] when there are none; the POST /forms and PUT /forms/{id}
responses echo the request and carry null when the list was omitted or
sent as null.

public_id.description:
Public identifier used in every public URL (/forms/public/{key}): 22
random URL-safe base64 characters assigned at creation and never changed,
so embeds keep working across edits.

status.description:
Publication state; only a published form is served by the public
endpoints. Defaults to draft.

submission_count.description: Number of live submissions the form has collected, spam included.

submit_action.description:
What the visitor sees after submitting: message shows thank_you_message
in place, redirect sends the browser to redirect_url. Defaults to
message.

thank_you_message.description:
Message shown after a submission when submit_action is message. When
empty a default text is shown (a "check your inbox" text for double
opt-in forms).
thank_you_message.example: Thanks, we will be in touch within one business day.

updated_at.description: When the record was last written (RFC 3339 date-time), set by the server on every update. Read-only.

count.description:
Number of suggestions to ask for, 1 to 25; absent or 0 means 10 (0 is
accepted: the binding skips a zero value). The engine may return fewer
usable suggestions than requested.

internal_handler.GeneratedAEOPromptsData.description: Suggested prompts returned by POST /aeo/prompts/generate. Nothing is stored until they are POSTed to /aeo/prompts.

prompts.description:
Suggested buyer-style questions: de-duplicated, each 12 to 500
characters, at most the requested count.
example: Which CRM is best for a small B2B sales team?

total.description:
Number of leads matching the request over all pages (also in
meta.total).

internal_handler.LoginRequest.description: Credentials for POST /auth/login. Unknown keys are ignored.

email.description: Login email address; must be syntactically valid (400 otherwise).

password.description: Account password; required, no further format check.

refresh_token.description:
Refresh token to revoke. Omitted or empty: every refresh token of the
caller is revoked. A token that is unknown, already revoked or owned by
another user is ignored.

marked.description: Number of notifications this call marked read (0 when none were unread).

message.description: Human-readable confirmation; informational, not a stable value.

new_password.description:
New password: at least 10 characters with an uppercase letter, a
lowercase letter, a digit and a special character. More than 72 bytes
fails with 500 (bcrypt limit) without spending the token.

token.description:
The token from the emailed link (its token query parameter). Single use,
valid for one hour.

email.description:
Email address of the account to reset; must be syntactically valid. The
response does not reveal whether an account exists.

currency.description:
ISO 4217 code, exactly three upper-case ASCII letters; the
deals.default_currency setting (EUR as shipped) when absent.

description.description:
Free-text description, at most 65535 bytes (UTF-8 bytes, not
characters).
description.example: Business-hours support for twelve months.

is_active.description: Whether quote lines may use the product; true when absent.

name.description:
Product name, required; trimmed, it must not be empty. At most 200
characters.

sku.description:
Optional stock-keeping code, trimmed, at most 64 characters; not
unique.

unit_price_cents.description:
Price of one unit in minor units, 0 to 1000000000000. Required; 0 (a
free item) is accepted.

currency.description:
New ISO 4217 code, exactly three upper-case ASCII letters. Existing
quote lines keep their prices.

description.description: New description, at most 65535 bytes; an empty string clears it.
description.example: Around-the-clock support for twelve months.

is_active.description:
New active flag; false stops the product from being added to quote
lines.

name.description: New name; trimmed, it must not be empty. At most 200 characters.

sku.description: New SKU, trimmed, at most 64 characters; an empty string clears it.

unit_price_cents.description: New unit price in minor units, 0 to 1000000000000.

description.description:
Line text override, at most 255 characters, trimmed; the product's
name when absent or blank.
description.example: Annual support plan, two sites

discount_bp.description:
Per-line discount in basis points, 0 to 10000 (1250 = 12.5 percent); 0
when absent.

product_id.description:
Product to price the line from: live, active and in the quote's
currency. Required, at least 1.

unit_price_cents.description:
Unit price override in minor units, 0 to 1000000000000; the product's
price when absent.

description.description:
New line text, at most 255 characters, trimmed; a blank value keeps
the stored text.
description.example: Annual support plan

discount_bp.description: New discount in basis points, 0 to 10000.

position.description:
New 1-based display position, at least 1. Other lines are not
renumbered, so positions may repeat.

unit_price_cents.description: New unit price in minor units, 0 to 1000000000000.

currency.description:
ISO 4217 code, exactly three upper-case ASCII letters; the
deals.default_currency setting (EUR as shipped) when absent. Every line
must be priced in it.

customer_id.description:
Customer the quote is addressed to (at least 1); must name a live
customer and, when deal_id is sent and the deal has a customer, that
customer. deal_id or customer_id is required.

deal_id.description:
Deal the quote grows from (at least 1). Must name a live deal that is
neither won nor lost; a sales user must own it. With no customer_id
the deal's customer is used (possibly none).

notes.description: Free-text notes, at most 65535 bytes (UTF-8 bytes, not characters).

owner_id.description:
Owner (at least 1); the caller when absent. A sales user may only send
its own id (403 otherwise); an admin may name any live user.

title.description:
Quote title, required; trimmed, it must not be empty. At most 200
characters.

valid_until.description:
Last day of validity, a calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (400 VALIDATION_ERROR
for any other form). Absent or empty means none.

status.description:
Target status. Required. Allowed moves: draft to sent; sent to
accepted, rejected, expired or back to draft.

currency.description:
New ISO 4217 code, exactly three upper-case ASCII letters; refused with
409 while the quote has lines.

customer_id.description:
New customer (at least 1; it cannot be cleared). Must name a live
customer and, when the quote's deal has a customer, that customer.

notes.description: New notes, at most 65535 bytes; an empty string clears them.
notes.example: Prices exclude VAT. Valid for one site.

owner_id.description:
New owner (at least 1). A sales user may only send its own id; an
admin may name any live user.

title.description: New title; trimmed, it must not be empty. At most 200 characters.

valid_until.description:
New last day of validity: a date YYYY-MM-DD sets it, null or an empty
string clears it, absent keeps it.

refresh_token.description:
The refresh token from the latest login, refresh or password change. It
is spent by this call.

internal_handler.RegisterRequest.description: Self-service sign-up. There is no role field: the account is always a customer.

email.description:
Login email address; must be a valid address and not already used by any
account (409 otherwise).

password.description:
Password: at least 10 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase
letter, a digit and a special character (punctuation or symbol). bcrypt
cannot hash more than 72 bytes; a longer password is answered with 400.

enabled.description:
True when POST /auth/register currently accepts sign-ups; false when the
setting is off or could not be read.

brand_aliases.description:
Alternative brand spellings: at most 20, each at most 120 characters.
Trimmed, blanks dropped and de-duplicated case-insensitively. Omitting the
field clears the list.

brand_name.description:
Brand name searched for in answers; required, at most 120 characters, and
not blank once trimmed.

competitors.description:
Tracked competitors, at most 20, kept in the order sent. Omitting the
field clears the list.

description.description:
What the business does; context for prompt generation only. At most 2000
characters; trimmed.
description.example: Self-hosted CRM for small sales and support teams.

owned_domains.description:
Owned domains: at most 20, each at most 255 characters. Normalised to
bare lower-case hosts (scheme, path and leading "www." removed),
de-duplicated. Omitting the field clears the list.

value.description:
The new value, as a JSON value of the entry's declared type: a string
for string, true or false for boolean, a whole number for integer, any
JSON value for float, json and array (stored as its JSON text). Falsy
values (false, 0, "") are accepted; the field must be present and must
not be null. For a sensitive entry send the plaintext secret, or "" to
clear it.

internal_handler.TaskListData.description: Data payload of GET /tasks and GET /tasks/my: one page of tasks and the total before pagination.

tasks.description: The page of tasks. Unsorted pages come in ascending id order; a sorted page is ordered by the sort column, then id in the same direction.

total.description: Number of tasks matching the caller's scope and filters before pagination; the same value as meta.total.

internal_handler.TicketListData.description: Data payload of the ticket list endpoints: one page of tickets and the total before pagination.

tickets.description: The page of tickets. Unsorted pages come in ascending id order; a sorted page is ordered by the sort column, then id in the same direction.

total.description: Number of tickets in the caller's scope matching the filters, before pagination; the same value as meta.total.

unread.description: Number of the caller's notifications that have not been marked read.

is_active.description:
Include (true) or exclude (false) the prompt from full runs. Absent keeps
the current state. Reactivating fails when 100 prompts are already active.

text.description:
New prompt text; at most 500 characters, not blank once trimmed, unique
case-insensitively among live prompts. Absent keeps the current text.
text.example: Which self-hosted CRM is best for a five-person sales team?

internal_handler.UpdateAPIKeyRequest.description: Body of PUT /api-keys/{id}. At least one field must be present.

is_active.description:
true reactivates a revoked key, false revokes it; omitted or null keeps
the current state.

name.description: New label, 3 to 100 characters; omitted or null keeps the current one.

internal_handler.UpdateCustomerRequest.description: Body of PUT /customers/{id}. Every field is optional. A text field that is omitted or empty leaves the stored value unchanged (it cannot be cleared this way), except website, where an empty string clears it.

address.description: New street address; empty leaves it unchanged.

city.description: New city; empty leaves it unchanged.

company.description: New free-text company name; empty leaves it unchanged.

company_id.description:
Company link: omitted or null leaves it unchanged, 0 clears it, any
other value must name a live company (400 INVALID_REFERENCE otherwise).

country.description: New country; empty leaves it unchanged.

email.description:
New email address; must be valid and not used by another customer (409).
Empty leaves it unchanged.

first_name.description: New given name; empty leaves it unchanged.

last_name.description: New family name; empty leaves it unchanged.

notes.description: New notes, replacing the old ones; empty leaves them unchanged.

phone.description: New phone number; empty leaves it unchanged.

position.description: New job title; empty leaves it unchanged.

postal_code.description: New postal code; empty leaves it unchanged.

state.description: New state, county or region; empty leaves it unchanged.

website.description:
Web site: omitted or null leaves it unchanged, "" clears it, anything
else must be an absolute http or https URL with a host, at most 255
characters after trimming.

allowed_domains.description:
Origin allowlist of bare host names with optional port (no scheme, no
path), lower-cased on save; empty allows every origin. At most 20, each
at most 255 characters.

captcha_enabled.description:
Require a reCAPTCHA v3 token; ignored unless the server has both
reCAPTCHA keys.

confirmation_body.description:
Confirmation mail body (plain text) with an optional {confirmation_link}
placeholder; the link is appended when the placeholder is missing.

confirmation_subject.description:
Confirmation mail subject, at most 255 characters; empty means a
built-in subject.

consent_text.description:
Consent statement; when non-empty every submission must carry
consent=true.
consent_text.example: I agree to be contacted about my enquiry.

content_url.description: Link substituted for {content_link}, at most 512 characters.

create_lead.description:
Feed accepted submissions into leads. Absent means true; send false
explicitly to turn it off.

default_owner_id.description:
Owner of created leads; 0 means none. Must be non-zero when create_lead
is true or absent, and any non-zero value must name an existing, active
admin or sales user.

description.description: Internal description for staff; never shown publicly.
description.example: Contact form on the pricing page.

double_opt_in.description:
Enable double opt-in (confirmation mail with a 48-hour single-use link
before the submission counts).

fields.description:
Ordered field definitions, 1 to 50. Exactly one field of type email,
named "email"; names unique and matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,49}$; select
fields need 1 to 50 non-blank options and only select fields may have
options; hidden fields cannot be required.

follow_up_body.description:
Follow-up mail body (plain text); {content_link} is replaced by
content_url. Empty means a built-in text.

follow_up_subject.description:
Follow-up mail subject, at most 255 characters; empty disables the
follow-up mail.

name.description: Form name; required, at most 255 characters, not blank once trimmed.

notify_emails.description:
Staff addresses notified of each accepted submission: at most 20, each
at most 255 characters and shaped like an email address (trimmed).

redirect_url.description:
Target page when submit_action is redirect: required then and must
start with http:// or https:// (trimmed). At most 512 characters.

status.description:
Publication state; absent or empty means draft. Only published forms are
served publicly.

submit_action.description: message (default when absent or empty) or redirect.

thank_you_message.description:
Message shown after submitting when submit_action is message; empty
means a built-in text.
thank_you_message.example: Thanks, we will be in touch within one business day.

internal_handler.UpdateLabelRequest.description: Body of PUT /labels/{id}. Both fields are optional; an absent or empty field is left unchanged.

color.description: New colour as #RRGGBB; absent or empty keeps the current colour.

name.description: New name, at most 50 characters, trimmed and unique case-insensitively among the other labels; absent or empty keeps the current name.

classification.description: New classification; empty or absent keeps the stored one.

company.description: New free-text company name; empty or absent keeps the stored one.

company_id.description:
Company link: absent keeps it, 0 clears it, any other value must name
a live company (400 INVALID_REFERENCE otherwise).

email.description:
New email address, validated when present; empty or absent keeps the
stored one. The email-or-phone rule of create is not re-checked.

external_id.description: New external id; empty or absent keeps the stored one.

first_name.description: New given name; empty or absent keeps the stored one.

last_name.description: New family name; empty or absent keeps the stored one.

notes.description:
New notes, replacing the stored text; at most 65535 bytes (400
BAD_REQUEST above). Empty or absent keeps the stored notes.

owner_id.description:
New owner. Admin only: any owner_id from another role, even the
caller's own id, is 403.

phone.description: New phone number; empty or absent keeps the stored one.

position.description: New job title; empty or absent keeps the stored one.

source.description: New source; empty or absent keeps the stored one.

status.description:
New status; empty or absent keeps the stored one. converted is refused
with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR unless the lead is already converted.

internal_handler.UpdateMeRequest.description: Body of PUT /users/me. Every field is optional; an omitted or empty field leaves the stored value unchanged. Role and active status cannot be changed here.

email.description: New login email; must be valid and not used by another account (409).

first_name.description: New given name; empty leaves it unchanged.

last_name.description: New family name; empty leaves it unchanged.

password.description:
New password: at least 10 characters with an uppercase letter, a
lowercase letter, a digit and a special character. The current password
is not asked for and existing refresh tokens are NOT revoked (POST
/auth/change-password does both). More than 72 bytes fails with 500.

internal_handler.UpdateTaskRequest.description: Body of PUT /tasks/{id}. Every field is optional; absent or empty fields are left unchanged.

assigned_to_id.description: New assignee; absent, 0 or the current assignee leaves it unchanged. Any other value is admin-only (403 otherwise) and must name an existing, active user.

customer_id.description: Customer to link. When present without lead_id it replaces the association: the lead link is cleared and this customer (which must exist) is linked. Absent (or null) keeps the stored link.

description.description: New description; an absent or empty value leaves it unchanged (it cannot be cleared).
description.example: Quote sent, waiting for the signature.

due_date.description: New due date (RFC 3339); absent or null leaves it unchanged (it cannot be cleared).

label_ids.description:
Replacement label set, at most 100 ids, each positive. The field is a
pointer so the cases stay distinguishable: absent (or null) leaves the
labels untouched, while a present array, even an empty one, replaces the
whole set. An id that matches no label rejects the whole request with 400
INVALID_REFERENCE.

lead_id.description: Lead to link. When present it must name a lead the caller may see (404 otherwise), even when it equals the stored link. Absent keeps the stored link; null is the same as absent. Cannot be combined with customer_id.

priority.description: New priority; absent or empty leaves it unchanged.

status.description: New status; absent or empty leaves it unchanged. A completed task cannot be moved to any other status (400).

title.description: New title; an absent or empty value leaves the title unchanged.

internal_handler.UpdateTicketRequest.description: Body of PUT /tickets/{id}. Every field is optional; absent or empty fields are left unchanged.

assigned_to_id.description: New assignee, which must exist and hold the support or admin role (400 otherwise). Absent or null leaves it unchanged; the assignee cannot be removed. On a ticket that already has an assignee the new value is currently not stored (see the operation description).

description.description: New description; absent or empty leaves it unchanged.
description.example: The printer is visible again but prints blank pages.

priority.description: New priority; absent or empty leaves it unchanged.

resolution.description: Resolution text; absent or empty leaves it unchanged (it cannot be cleared).
resolution.example: Rolled the printer back to the previous firmware.

status.description: New status; absent or empty leaves it unchanged. A closed ticket cannot be moved to any other status (400); every other change is allowed.

title.description: New title; absent or empty leaves it unchanged.

internal_handler.UpdateUserRequest.description: Body of PUT /users/{id}. Every field is optional; an omitted or empty field leaves the stored value unchanged (names and email cannot be cleared).

email.description: New login email; must be valid and not used by another account (409).

first_name.description: New given name; empty leaves it unchanged.

is_active.description:
New active flag. Applied only when the caller is an admin and silently
ignored otherwise. false deactivates the account (its tokens and API keys
stop working); unlike POST /users/{id}/deactivate this path does not stop
an admin from deactivating itself.

last_name.description: New family name; empty leaves it unchanged.

role.description:
New role. Applied only when the caller is an admin and silently ignored
otherwise; a value outside admin, sales, support, customer is a 400 for
every caller.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Personal API key from POST /api-keys, sent in the same Authorization header as "Authorization: ApiKey <key>" (the gcrm_ prefix may be sent or left off). A header named ApiKey is not read. The plaintext key is shown only once, at creation.
ApiKeyAuth.name: Authorization

BearerAuth.description: JWT access token from POST /auth/login or POST /auth/refresh, sent as "Authorization: Bearer <jwt>". Valid until it expires; logout does not revoke it.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
